svg.text: App integration: one SDK for suite apps and external apps
The SDK button opens a pop-up. Suite apps go through Accounts, external apps straight to Passport. The app tab stays open.
Already have a pubky? Import it
external apps show their own name
2 if not signed in: pubkyauth://… request
6 app's callback URL with the child grant
7 same origin: hands it to the tab, closes the pop-up
4 signed grant, the app makes its Session
Pop-up blocked: the same steps in this tab
+ The app tab never leaves, so the page keeps its state.
+ One SDK button for every app. The SDK knows whether the app is in the suite.
+ Already signed in: suite apps need no click in the pop-up, external apps one approval.
+ Falls back to the same tab when a pop-up can't open.
+ Passport v2's client package already does the external half: button, pop-up, fallback, instance
− Suite path: Accounts sends Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin, which cuts the link to the
app tab. The result comes back through the app's own callback page, which the SDK can ship.
− Suite path: with the link cut, the app can't see the pop-up close. Cancel needs a callback or a
− External path: no single sign-on. Each app's grant needs your key, so grant-only identities need
an SSO sign-in or a Ring approval per app.
− The pop-up needs a click in the app. The SDK button gives it one.
